status: Renderer-owned retained rounded controls adopted in GLOBAL/PROJECT; GPI-S2 remains in progress
selection: Rounded controls allocated contours and tessellated fans whenever Preferences geometry was prepared. CTL-01 requires renderer ownership, so persistence is passed explicitly through preparation rather than added as thread-local/global state.
production_paths: ProjectPreferencesWindow uses the same GlobalPreferencesWindowSurface and default preparation route
competing_paths_retired: Repeated fan tessellation on warm Global/Project Preferences preparation
Independent convex-fill generation at shared control call sites; one cached mesh generator now supplies them
remaining_competing_paths: Static PreparedScene construction and Main/New Project compatibility composition currently create temporary caches; their renderer-lifetime retention is not migrated or claimed.
Frame quads/vertices and clipping are still materialized; GPU control-mesh retention/instancing is not introduced.
change: ControlMeshCache is a Renderer field, with explicit borrowed ControlPainter flowing through Preferences primitives and row clipping. Local position-only meshes are reused across translation and color, while frame materialization applies live placement/color and the existing clip algorithm. Keys contain dimensions, normalized radius, border width, DPI, contour revision, segment tolerance and style generation. Current rounded contour revision/style policy is immutable. Renderer recreation starts cold; closure drops the owner.

bounds.rule: LRU eviction before retained insertion; oversized meshes bypass retention and are consumed transiently. Meshes are boxed fixed-size point arrays with no nested allocations. Cached references never escape materialization, so no CPU cache entry is pinned in flight.
bounds.accounting_proof: 256-entry fixture: 24576 mesh payload bytes, 8192 key bytes, 12288 entry storage bytes. Keys are included in entry storage, not additional to it. Separate byte-pressure test retains exactly 4194304 bytes in two entries; oversized bypass leaves existing accounting unchanged.
bounds.boundary: Complete retained CPU mesh payload bound only. Frame quad/vertex scratch, existing screen GPU streams, total/native/driver memory and the specified GPU control budget are not qualified here.

proof.cpu: All eight key components change identity; identical key hits avoid rebuilding. LRU promotion/eviction, entry/byte caps, oversized bypass, translation/color reuse and geometry/DPI misses pass.
proof.gpu_owner: Actual Renderer-owned Preferences preparation stays warm on repetition, changes identity at 1.5x DPI, matches fresh scene pixels and rebuilds after Renderer replacement.
proof.gpu_aa: Cached rounded geometry matches the original general scanline boundary pixels for the existing size/radius/fractional-position matrix on Intel P630/Vulkan.
proof.gpu_scroll: Fractional scroll proof now uses the migrated Renderer preparation API: repeated scroll cycle adds no control mesh builds, reuses text, preserves pinned chrome and restores original pixels.
proof.negative: Omitting DPI fails the independent key-change proof. Disabling mesh reuse fails the actual Renderer warm-preparation proof. Both mutations restored byte-for-byte before final positives/lint/release.
proof.app: Three GlobalPreferencesWindowSurface tests pass. Initial --lib invocation failed because datum-gui-app has only a binary target; corrected command/result retained. Full app suite not rerun; known unrelated terminal lineage/convergence issues remain.
proof.native: Fresh release X11 MAIN zoom-in/out and GLOBAL/PROJECT/NEW startup/presentation/close smoke pass with exit zero. Only GLOBAL/PROJECT persistent cache adoption is claimed; native tessellation counters/performance not qualified.
proof.build_lint: Offline guarded release and renderer library/tests Clippy pass. Initial items-after-test-module lint corrected by moving Renderer methods before tests; no logic change. Failure retained.
proof.governance: Source health, dependency authority, parity, traceability/spec/project, diff and staged rustfmt checked before commit. Test-only helper moved after production functions to meet source-health inline-tail rules; no ceiling raised.

limits: Persistent cache adoption is GLOBAL/PROJECT only. Main/New Project and other control families remain pending; no global control adoption or S3 completion.
This retains CPU meshes; frame translation/color/clip materialization and screen uploads still occur under their existing owners. No zero-allocation or numerical speedup claim.
Full per-adapter key omission/eviction negatives, native shape counters, GPU control capacity and complete resource/backend/scale/endurance qualification remain open.
Concave/holed authored geometry remains on its existing tessellator. No dependency, vendoring, version/license, visual prototype, typography, engine mutation or resize qualification change.
